layout.heroStructure: centered top nav with notice bar above, left-aligned oversized headline block followed by a single-line input+CTA form, then a large full-width product screenshot panel below the fold
layout.grid: single-column centered content track with a max-width container; dashboard mockup breaks out to a wider inset panel
layout.containerWidth: narrow-to-medium centered column (roughly 1100-1200px) for text content, widening to near-full-bleed for the product screenshot panel
layout.contentAlignment: left-aligned headline and supporting copy, left-aligned form controls, no center-justified body text
layout.imagePlacement: single large hero product screenshot placed directly beneath the CTA form inside a soft dotted-pattern card
layout.header: slim dark announcement strip pinned above a white sticky nav with logo left, dropdown nav items center-left, text link and two differentiated buttons (outline-ish ghost + solid dark) right

typography.fontPersonality: geometric sans-serif with a slightly rounded, confident, tech-editorial feel
typography.headingScale: very large display headline (roughly 60-72px) against small 11-12px uppercase label text above it, creating an extreme size jump
typography.weight: bold/heavy for the hero headline, medium for nav and body, semibold for buttons
typography.lineHeight: tight leading on the display headline (near 1.05-1.1), relaxed leading on the subcopy paragraph (around 1.5)
typography.letterSpacing: wide tracked uppercase for the small eyebrow label, normal tracking elsewhere
typography.hierarchy: three-tier stack: tiny uppercase eyebrow, massive headline, medium-weight subheading paragraph, then compact form

color.saturation: mostly desaturated neutrals with one piercing high-saturation accent color used sparingly on primary CTAs
color.temperature: cool-neutral overall grayscale palette punctuated by a warm-leaning acid-yellow-green accent

photography.composition: no human photography in the hero; product UI screenshot is the sole visual, framed as a floating browser-window card with layered secondary panels peeking from behind
photography.lighting: flat, even studio-style lighting simulated through soft neutral shadows under the floating UI card
photography.colorGrading: clean neutral white-balanced grading with muted grays, no stylized color cast
photography.cameraAngle: flat frontal/orthogonal view of the UI window, no perspective tilt
photography.depthOfField: layered flat planes rather than optical blur; background panel is slightly offset and dimmed to imply depth
photography.humanPose: not applicable, no human subjects present in this view
photography.environment: abstract dotted-grid backdrop pattern standing in for a physical environment
photography.texture: subtle dot-grid texture on the background surface, otherwise flat and smooth UI surfaces
photography.imageRatio: wide landscape panel roughly 16:9 to 2:1 for the product screenshot container

components.buttons: pill-to-rounded-rectangle buttons with two tiers: a dark near-black solid primary and a bright accent-colored solid secondary, both with medium padding and no visible border
components.cards: flat white/light-gray cards with very subtle borders and minimal shadow, used for the floating product screenshot window
components.forms: single-line combined input and button bar, input with thin gray border and rounded corners, placeholder text in muted gray
components.navigation: horizontal top nav with dropdown chevrons, logo mark plus wordmark on the left, utility links and dual-tier CTAs on the right
components.border: hairline 1px light gray borders on inputs, cards, and the nav bottom edge
components.radius: medium rounded corners (roughly 8-12px) on buttons, inputs, and cards
components.shadow: very soft, low-opacity drop shadow beneath the floating screenshot card for subtle lift

spacing.sectionGap: generous vertical gap (roughly 80-120px equivalent) between header, hero copy, and the screenshot panel
spacing.containerPadding: moderate horizontal padding (around 64-80px on desktop) framing the centered content column
spacing.cardPadding: comfortable internal padding on the input/button bar and the screenshot frame, roughly 16-24px
spacing.contentGap: moderate gap (around 16-24px) between eyebrow label, headline, subcopy, and form
spacing.heroWhitespace: ample open whitespace above and below the headline, letting the oversized type breathe against a plain white field

motion.fade: likely gentle fade-in on hero text elements as the page loads
motion.reveal: scroll-triggered reveal of the product screenshot and metrics bar as they enter viewport
motion.scroll: subtle parallax-like layering between the front and back UI panels on scroll
motion.hover: slight brightness or lift change on buttons and nav dropdown items on hover
motion.transition: fast, short-duration easing transitions (150-250ms) for interactive state changes
